title: Toxicity Assay for Inducer Compounds in Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6tghejw

steps.title: Prepare Initial Preculture
steps.instruction: Inoculate BG11 medium with the chosen cyanobacterial strain and grow for 3-5 days until an OD 750 of ~1 is reached.

substeps.instruction: Calculate inoculation volume based on concentrations and replicates (e.g., 3 concentrations x 3 replicates x 30 mL = 270 mL).
Use a 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask for 100 mL culture volume (accounting for ~1:3 dilution).
Include appropriate antibiotics if the strain carries a plasmid.

steps.title: First Dilution of Preculture
steps.instruction: Dilute the pre-cultures to an OD 750 of 0.2, ensuring cultures are no older than 1 week and no further than early stationary phase.

steps.title: Regrow Preculture
steps.instruction: Grow the diluted pre-culture for an additional 2-3 days until the OD 750 reaches ~0.6.

steps.title: Prepare Main Culture and Aliquot
steps.instruction: Dilute the preculture to OD 750 = 0.1 in a large sterile vessel and aliquot into smaller flasks.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the culture into 100 mL Erlenmeyer flasks, adding 30 mL per well.
Ensure at least three biological replicates per inducer concentration.

steps.title: Add Inducer Compounds
steps.instruction: Add inducer compounds (L-rhamnose, aTc, vanillic acid, or CoCl2) according to the specific pipetting schemes, ensuring the total volume added is equal for each replicate.

substeps.instruction: Achieve equal volume by either preparing a stock solution for each concentration or adding the difference in volume of the solvent used.

steps.title: Monitor Growth and Measure OD
steps.instruction: Measure the OD 750 of each culture daily for at least 7 days, or until the culture becomes stationary.

substeps.instruction: Perform an additional dilution step for precise measurement if the OD is above 1.0.
If using an incubator with CO2-enriched air, measure the OD twice a day due to higher growth rates.
